summary: All 10 requirements (REQ-75 through REQ-84) are fully implemented. The backend adds the category field to the Product type and updates createProduct/updateProduct methods. The frontend adds category inputs to BulkProductUpload and ProductManagementTable, displays category in ProductCard and ProductDetailView, adds a separate Category filter section in Marketplace with independent filter logic, and updates useQueries hooks to handle the category field. A migration module ensures backward compatibility.
